name: Data submission

title: Data submission
labels: data-submission
---

You can provide here a paper name and DOI. The data will be extracted from the figures. Any information about samples and/or experiments is also welcome.

## Source paper
- **Title:**
- **Authors:**
- **Journal / year:**
- **DOI:** (required — every dataset cites its source with a clickable DOI link)

## Figures
Which figure(s) should the data be digitized from?

## Samples and experiments (anything you know helps)
- **Material(s):** name and kind (e.g. yield-stress fluid, polymer solution, …)
- **Geometry:** cone–plate, parallel plate, Couette, capillary, … (with details if you have them: cone angle/diameter, gap, …)
- **Temperature(s):**
- **Protocol:** pre-shear, equilibration time, sweep direction, points per decade, …

## Community data
If this is your own data rather than a literature digitization, tell us how to get the raw files and confirm you are happy for them to be published in the registry under the project's open license.
